FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Questions About
Blasting & Painting?

Find answers to common questions about our abrasive blasting,
shot blasting, sand blasting, industrial painting and protective
coating services.

What is abrasive blasting?

Abrasive blasting is a surface preparation process
used to remove rust, old coatings, scale and other
surface contaminants before painting or applying
protective coatings.

Do you provide shot blasting services?

Yes. We provide shot blasting services for industrial
components and fabricated surfaces where effective
cleaning and surface preparation are required.

Do you provide sand blasting services?

Yes. Our sand blasting services are suitable for
industrial surface cleaning and preparation before
painting and other coating applications.

Do you provide industrial painting services?

Yes. We provide industrial painting solutions for
fabricated components and industrial surfaces based
on application and project requirements.

What is the difference between blasting and painting?

Blasting prepares and cleans the surface by removing
contaminants and unwanted layers. Painting is then
used to provide the required protective or finishing
coating.

Do you provide glass flake coating services?

Yes. Glass flake coating can be provided as a
protective coating solution for suitable industrial
applications according to project requirements.

Can you handle large fabricated components?

We undertake industrial surface preparation and
coating requirements for fabricated components based
on the size, material and application requirements of
the project.

Do you also provide fabrication services?

Yes. In addition to surface treatment, we also support
industrial fabrication requirements including sheet
metal fabrication and customized industrial components.
